# Load spe

```{r load spe}

```

# Prepare spe for analysis

```{r prep spe}
# Create a new data frame with all the colData of the spe object - to recode the patient_id column

metadata <- colData(spe)

# add a new column to metadata called Donor where you recode the patient_id column
# the elements starting with NH should be called Healthy1, Healthy2, etc.
# the elements starting with SSc should be called SSc1, SSc2, etc.
metadata$Donor <- dplyr::recode(metadata$patient_id,
                                     Healthy1="Healthy1",
                                     Healthy2="Healthy2", 
                                     SSc1="SSc1",
                                     SSc2="SSc2",
                                     SSc3="SSc3",
                                     SSc4="SSc4",
                                     SSc5="SSc5",
                                     SSc6="SSc6",
                                     SSc7="SSc7",
                                     SSc8="SSc8",
                                     Healthy3="Healthy3",
                                     Healthy4="Healthy4",
                                     SSc9="SSc9",
                                     Healthy5="Healthy5",
                                     Healthy6="Healthy6",
                                     Healthy7="Healthy7")


metadata$Disease <- dplyr::recode(metadata$indication,
                                  NH="Healthy",
                                  SSc="SSc")

metadata$ILD <- dplyr::recode(metadata$ILD,
                                     healthy="healthy",
                                     "1"="ILD", 
                                     "0"="no ILD")

metadata$Arthritis[is.na(metadata$Arthritis)] <- "no arthritis"

# Assign the new column in metadata to the spe object
spe$Donor <- metadata$Donor
spe$ILD <- metadata$ILD
spe$Arthritis <- metadata$Arthritis
spe$Disease <- metadata$Disease

names(colData(spe))[which(names(colData(spe))=="Skin.progression.at.biopsy")]="Progression_skin"
names(colData(spe))[which(names(colData(spe))=="Subtype.(dc/lc)")]="Subtype_dc_lc"

met_markers <- c("Glut1",
                 "HK1",
                 "PFKL1",
                 "PKM2",
                 "LDHA",
                 "GAPDH",
                 "CS",
                 "OGDH",
                 "ATP5A",
                 "SDHA",
                 "CD98",
                 "ACAC",
                 "CPT1a",
                 "G6PD",
                 "p_mTOR",
                 "pAMPK",
                 "NOX4",
                 "HIF1a",
                 "PGC-1a",
                 "TFAM",
                 "NRF2_p")

glycolysis_markers <- c("Glut1",
                 "HK1",
                 "PFKL1",
                 "PKM2",
                 "LDHA",
                 "GAPDH")

no_met_markers <- setdiff(rownames(spe),met_markers) 
rowData(spe)$use_channel_met_markers <- rownames(spe) %in% met_markers
rowData(spe)$use_channel_glyc_markers <- rownames(spe) %in% glycolysis_markers

# define clinical categories
clinical_cat <- c("Disease","Progression_skin", "Arthritis", "DU.history", "ILD", "Subtype_dc_lc", "Early.or.not")

spe[[clinical_cat[1]]] <- factor(spe[[clinical_cat[1]]], levels = c("Healthy", "SSc"))
spe[[clinical_cat[2]]] <- factor(spe[[clinical_cat[2]]], levels = c("healthy", "progressive", "stable"))
spe[[clinical_cat[3]]] <- factor(spe[[clinical_cat[3]]], levels = c("healthy","arthritis","no arthritis"))
spe[[clinical_cat[4]]] <- factor(spe[[clinical_cat[4]]], levels = c("healthy","DU history","no DU history"))
spe[[clinical_cat[5]]] <- factor(spe[[clinical_cat[5]]], levels = c("healthy","ILD","no ILD"))
spe[[clinical_cat[6]]] <- factor(spe[[clinical_cat[6]]], levels = c("healthy","dcSSc","lcSSc"))
spe[[clinical_cat[7]]] <- factor(spe[[clinical_cat[7]]], levels = c("healthy","early","late"))

# define color vectors
color_vectors <- list()
pheno_clusters_new <- setNames(c("#C4281C","#C2DAB8","#E8BAC8","#80BBDB","#C470A0","#0D69AC","#F5CD30","#287F47",
                                 "#A05F35","#D9856C","#6B327C","#008F9C","#C7D23C","#B7D7D5","#923978","#27462D",
                                 "#FF9494","#938767","#FFF67B","#E1A4C2","#FC7B1B","#CD6298","#102ADC"), 
                               as.character(unique(spe$pheno_clusters_new)))

indication <- setNames(c("#4DBBD533", "#E64B35AA"),
                       c(unique(colData(spe)$Disease)))

Donor <- setNames(c("#FFFF33", "#FFCC66",'#FF9933','#FF6633','#00FFFF','#FF0033','#79B5B5', '#C470A0',
                         '#996633','#999933','#99CC33','#FF9494', '#33FF33','#336633', '#330066','#923978'),
                       c(unique(colData(spe)$Donor)))

Neighbourhood_del_80_pheno_new <- setNames(c("#CC00CC", "#260EEC", "#FFCA28", "#004D40","#FF6633","#66FF66", 
                                             "#EF9EA7", "#990000", "#CC0033","#4FC3F7"),
                                           unique(spe$Neighbourhood_del_80_pheno_new))

color_vectors$clusters <- pheno_clusters_new
color_vectors$Disease <- indication
color_vectors$Donor <- Donor
color_vectors$neighbourhood_del_80_pheno_new <- Neighbourhood_del_80_pheno_new

color_vectors[[clinical_cat[2]]] <- setNames(c("#4DBBD533", "#C03830", "#F6BF93"), unique(spe[[clinical_cat[2]]]))
color_vectors[[clinical_cat[3]]] <- setNames(c("#4DBBD533","#377EB8","#4DAF4A"), unique(spe[[clinical_cat[3]]]))
color_vectors[[clinical_cat[4]]] <- setNames(c("#4DBBD533","#FC8D62","#8DA0CB"), unique(spe[[clinical_cat[4]]]))
color_vectors[[clinical_cat[5]]] <- setNames(c("#4DBBD533","#FFFFB3","#BEBADA"), unique(spe[[clinical_cat[5]]]))
color_vectors[[clinical_cat[6]]] <- setNames(c("#4DBBD533","#A6D854","#FFD92F"), unique(spe[[clinical_cat[6]]]))
color_vectors[[clinical_cat[7]]] <- setNames(c("#4DBBD533","#F781BF","#999999"), unique(spe[[clinical_cat[7]]]))

metadata(spe)$colors_vectors$Progression_skin <- setNames(c("#6CC3F4", "#C03830", "#F6BF93"),
                                                          unique(spe$Progression_skin))

metadata(spe)$color_vectors <- color_vectors

rm(metadata)

unique(spe$pheno_clusters_new)

spe$pheno_clusters_new2 <- case_when(
  grepl("CD45_CD3",spe$pheno_clusters_new) ~ "CD45",
  TRUE ~ spe$pheno_clusters_new
)

spe$pheno_clusters_new2 <- recode(
  spe$pheno_clusters_new2,
  "CD31_1" = "Met<sup>low</sup>_EC",
  "CD31_2" = "TCA/OXPHOS<sup>hi</sup><br>PGC-1α<sup>hi</sup>_EC",
  "CD31_3" = "Met<sup>hi</sup>_EC",
  "CD31_4" = "pmTOR<sup>hi</sup>CD98<sup>hi</sup>_EC",
  "CD31_5" = "Glycolysis<sup>hi</sup><br>TCA/OXPHOS<sup>int</sup>PPP<sup>hi</sup>_EC",
  "CD45_CD68_1" = "Met<sup>hi</sup>_Mf",
  "CD45_CD68_2" = "Met<sup>low</sup>_Mf",
  "CD45_CD68_3" = "Glycolysis<sup>low</sup><br>TCA/OXPHOS<sup>hi</sup>_Mf",
  "CD45_CD68_4" = "Glycolysis<sup>hi</sup><br>TCA/OXPHOS<sup>hi</sup>_Mf",
  "stromal_1" = "TCA/OXPHOS<sup>hi</sup><br>PGC-1α<sup>hi</sup>_Fib",
  "stromal_2" = "Met<sup>hi</sup>_Fib",
  "stromal_3" = "TCA/OXPHOS<sup>int</sup><br>PGC-1α<sup>hi</sup>_Fib",
  "stromal_4" = "pmTOR<sup>hi</sup>CD98<sup>hi</sup>_Fib",
  "stromal_5" = "Met<sup>low</sup>_Fib",
  "stromal_6" = "Glycolysis<sup>int</sup><br>CS<sup>hi</sup>OGDH<sup>low</sup>_Fib",
  "stromal_7" = "Glut<sup>hi</sup>_Fib",
  "stromal_8" = "Glycolysis<sup>int</sup><br>PGC-1α<sup>low</sup>FAO<sup>low</sup>_Fib"
)

unique(spe$pheno_clusters_new2)
```


# Create R interaction dotplot

```{r interaction-dotplot, echo=TRUE, fig.width=30, fig.height=12}
library(ggsci)

interaction_all <- metadata(spe)$interaction_test_1$results 
interaction_all$from_label <- case_when(
  grepl("^CD45_CD3", interaction_all$from_label) ~ "CD45",
  TRUE ~ interaction_all$from_label
)

interaction_all$to_label <- case_when(
  grepl("^CD45_CD3", interaction_all$to_label) ~ "CD45",
  TRUE ~ interaction_all$to_label
)

interact.summary <- interaction_all  %>%
  group_by(Progression_skin, from_label, to_label) %>%
  summarize(MeanSig = mean(sigval, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(
    InteractType = case_when(MeanSig > 0 ~ 'Attraction', MeanSig < 0 ~ 'Avoidance', .default = 'NoInteraction')
  ) %>%
  mutate(AbsMeanSig = abs(MeanSig))

#Plot interaction split in healthy, progressive and stable SSc
ggplot(interact.summary) +
  geom_point(aes(
    x = to_label,
    y = from_label,
    size = AbsMeanSig,
    color = InteractType
  )) +
  facet_wrap( ~ Progression_skin) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(panel.grid  = element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 90,
    vjust = 0.5,
    hjust = 1
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    'Attraction' = '#E64B35CC',
    'Avoidance' = '#4DBBD577'
  )) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0, 10), limits = c(0.05, 1))

#Plot interaction split in progressive and stable SSc
ggplot(interact.summary %>% filter(Progression_skin != "healthy")) +
  geom_point(aes(
    x = to_label,
    y = from_label,
    size = AbsMeanSig,
    color = InteractType
  )) +
  facet_wrap( ~ Progression_skin) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(panel.grid  = element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 90,
    vjust = 0.5,
    hjust = 1
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    'Attraction' = '#E64B35CC',
    'Avoidance' = '#4DBBD577'
  )) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0, 10), limits = c(0.05, 1))

# Plot interaction split in healthy and SSc
ggplot(interact.summary %>% mutate(
  Healthy_SSc = case_when(
    Progression_skin %in% c("stable", "progressive") ~ "SSc",
    TRUE ~ "Healthy"
  )
)) +
  geom_point(aes(
    x = to_label,
    y = from_label,
    size = AbsMeanSig,
    color = InteractType
  )) +
  facet_wrap( ~ Healthy_SSc) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(panel.grid  = element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 90,
    vjust = 0.5,
    hjust = 1
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    'Attraction' = '#E64B35CC',
    'Avoidance' = '#4DBBD577'
  )) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0, 10), limits = c(0.05, 1))
```

```{r interaction-graph, echo=TRUE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}

met_markers <- c(
  "Glut1",
  "HK1",
  "PFKL1",
  "PKM2",
  "LDHA",
  "GAPDH",
  "CS",
  "OGDH",
  "ATP5A",
  "SDHA",
  "CD98",
  "ACAC",
  "CPT1a",
  "G6PD",
  "p_mTOR",
  "pAMPK",
  "NOX4",
  "HIF1a",
  "PGC-1a",
  "TFAM",
  "NRF2_p"
)

no_met_markers <- setdiff(rownames(spe), met_markers)
rowData(spe)$use_channel_met_markers <- rownames(spe) %in% met_markers

spe_use <- spe[rownames(spe[rowData(spe)$use_channel_met_markers])]
spe_use <- spe_use[, !spe_use$pheno_clusters_new2 %in% c("CD45", "Ecad")]

expression_data <- as.data.frame(t(assay(spe_use, "z-rescaled_new")))
expression_data$Donor <- colData(spe_use)$Donor
expression_data$Disease <- colData(spe_use)$indication
expression_data$Clusters <- colData(spe_use)$pheno_clusters_new2
#expression_data <- expression_data %>% filter (grepl("^str",Clusters))

exprs_median = expression_data %>% group_by(Clusters) %>%
  select(-Donor, -Disease, -Clusters) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), median, na.rm = TRUE))

head(exprs_median)

X_all = exprs_median[, c(-1)]
set.seed(2062)
tsne = Rtsne((X_all),
             dims = 2,
             verbose = TRUE,
             check_duplicates = F,
             perplexity = 5
)
tsne_plot <- data.frame(x = tsne$Y[, 1], y = tsne$Y[, 2])
ggplot(tsne_plot) + geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y))  + theme_classic()

interact.graph <- interact.summary %>% filter (!from_label %in% c("CD45", "Ecad"),!to_label %in% c("CD45", "Ecad"))

interact.graph <- interact.graph %>% filter (grepl("^str",from_label))
# Setting AbsMeanSig to 0 if to_label is not a certain population
interact.graph$AbsMeanSig <- ifelse(grepl("^CD31", interact.graph$to_label), interact.graph$AbsMeanSig, 0)

freq <- dittoSeq::dittoBarPlot(spe,
                               var = "pheno_clusters_new2",
                               group.by = "indication",
                               data.out = TRUE)$data

interact.graph$from <- interact.graph$from_label
interact.graph$to <- interact.graph$to_label

## aggregate directional data int undirectional
interact.graph$from <- interact.graph$from_label
interact.graph$to <- interact.graph$to_label
# remove bidirectional
interact.graph <- interact.graph %>%
  mutate(pair = pmin(from, to),  # Create a pair column that orders 'from' and 'to'
         pair_rev = pmax(from, to)) %>%  # Create the reverse pair for comparison
  group_by(Progression_skin, pair, pair_rev) %>%
  slice(which.max(AbsMeanSig)) %>%  # Keeps the row with the largest AbsMeanSig
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-pair, -pair_rev)

graph <- as_tbl_graph(interact.graph, directed = FALSE)

ggraph(graph, tsne_plot) +
  geom_edge_fan(aes(color = factor(InteractType), width = AbsMeanSig), show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_edge_width_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3), limits = c(0.3, 1)) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c(
    'Attraction' = '#E64B35AA',
    'Avoidance' = '#4DBBD533'
  )) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = name), size = 6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(spe)$color_vectors$clusters) +
  # Node labels with Markdown support
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name),
    size = 3,                  # Adjust text size as needed
    family = "Arial",          # Choose a suitable font family
    repel = TRUE,              # Optional: to avoid label overlap
    show.legend = FALSE        # Hide legend for text labels
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(panel.grid  = element_blank(),
            # Enable Markdown rendering for all text elements
    text = element_markdown()) +
  facet_edges( ~ Progression_skin)

interact.graph2 <- interact.graph %>% mutate(Healthy_SSc = case_when(
  Progression_skin %in%
    c("stable", "progressive") ~ "SSc",
  TRUE ~ "Healthy"
))
graph2 <- as_tbl_graph(interact.graph2, directed = FALSE)

ggraph(graph2, tsne_plot) +
  geom_edge_fan(aes(color = factor(InteractType), width = AbsMeanSig), show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_edge_width_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3), limits = c(0.3, 1)) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c(
    'Attraction' = '#E64B35AA',
    'Avoidance' = '#4DBBD533'
  )) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = name), size = 6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(spe)$color_vectors$clusters) +
  # Node labels with Markdown support
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name),
    size = 3,                  # Adjust text size as needed
    family = "Arial",          # Choose a suitable font family
    repel = TRUE,              # Optional: to avoid label overlap
    show.legend = FALSE        # Hide legend for text labels
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(panel.grid  = element_blank(),
            # Enable Markdown rendering for all text elements
    text = element_markdown()) +
  facet_edges( ~ Healthy_SSc)

```
